key_decisions.rationale: Keeps solemn saying, fold, gate, climbing, and two predatory roles.
key_decisions.before: “Truly, truly, I tell you, the one who does not enter the sheepfold through the door but climbs in another way is a thief and a robber.
key_decisions.after: “Truly, truly, I tell you, anyone who does not enter the sheepfold through the gate but climbs in some other way is a thief and a robber.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in by another way—that one is a thief and a robber.

key_decisions.before: So Jesus said again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the door for the sheep.
key_decisions.after: So Jesus told them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So Jesus again said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves self-identification and voluntary sacrificial life.
key_decisions.before: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
key_decisions.after: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps other sheep, divine necessity, voice, and unity without erasing distinct origins.
key_decisions.before: I have other sheep that are not from this fold. I must bring them too, and they will listen to my voice. There will be one flock, one shepherd.
key_decisions.after: I have other sheep that are not from this fold. I must bring them too, and they will listen to my voice. Then there will be one flock, one shepherd.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. So there will be one flock, one shepherd.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps agency, repeated authority, resurrection, command, and Father.
key_decisions.before: No one takes it from me. I lay it down from myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. I received this command from my Father.”
key_decisions.after: No one takes it from me; I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. I received this command from my Father.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps plural persons and singular unity.
key_decisions.before: I and the Father are one.”
key_decisions.after: I and the Father are one.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I and the Father are one.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves conditional argument, divine word, and scriptural durability.

key_decisions.after: If Scripture called those to whom God’s word came ‘gods’—and Scripture cannot be undone—
